name: Epic Gem of Many Facets
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Gem of Many Facets

effects.name: Craftable (hidden)
effects.tooltip: Craftable : This item can be enhanced via Essence Crafting .

flavor_text: From this chain hangs a gem that is very finely cut, giving it countless glittering faces. It can take the place of various other items for the purpose of activating certain set bonuses. This item will randomly choose from available set bonuses whenever it is re-acquired or upgraded to a higher level version. This item is also keyed for Essence Crafting , and may be Disjuncted so that it can be crafted upon. Note that upgrading this item to a higher level version through Epic or Legendary Crafting will destroy what has been crafted on it, and will also re-roll available set bonuses.
tips: This item cannot be fed to sentient jewels . You can reroll the sets for free at Legacy Altar of Epic Rituals . (This destroys all augments, adamantine rituals, Curses or Essence Crafting enhancements.)

source.raw: Epic version of Gem of Many Facets
